short_description: Compose persistent server-authoritative equipment, live ENet replication and character presentation in one production-shaped runtime.
purpose: Close the remaining composition gap between accepted CH9.2 Inventory UI, CH9.3 live ENet equipment replication and CH9.4 M6 durability/recovery without creating a second transport, persistence model or character truth.
